_note: Per-repository setup and test scope for ticket agents. needs are sibling repos the setup expects next to this one; they are cloned read-only and never pushed. Every test inside the run folder runs without asking (tier 0); unitTests are what the run prompt names, and allowedTestCommands record each repository's unit tests. The demo company's repos: replace them with yours.

acme/shop-worker.notes: The queue consumers are tested with an in-memory broker; the end-to-end suite runs in CI.

acme/shop-shared.notes: A library: CI runs this jest suite with no service containers; the Redis and Kafka specs use mocks.

acme/shop-api.notes: Only the unit tier runs in-process. The integration and soak tiers need Postgres and Redis: slower, and some may not work in the sandbox.

acme/shop-infra.notes: No unit test suite: this repo builds Docker images and docs. Docker is not available to agents yet.

acme/shop-local-deploy.notes: Local tooling with no CI. shop.sh, docker and kubectl drive real environments: agents use the kube and aws tools instead. This repo has no branch protection, so the tiers are its only check.
